methodology.corpus: One current built-in adapter and core-command corpus shared by every method; host inventory and user overlays excluded
methodology.lexical_analysis: Frozen NFKC bilingual tokenizer and alias expansion; same document tokens and frequency counts
methodology.full_engine: Complete src snapshot bundled at the named revision; private scorer exported only in temporary benchmark copies
methodology.bm25: k1=1.2 b=0.75; token-count document length; BM25 IDF
methodology.tfidf: Cosine similarity using normalized term frequency and the same BM25 IDF as the frozen hybrid
methodology.minisearch: Installed locked MiniSearch 7.2.0; default BM25+ k=1.2 b=0.7 delta=0.5, matched-query-term multiplier, unique-term field length, OR matching; exact and official README fuzzy=0.2 presets; prefix disabled
methodology.build_boundary: Same command-document objects through tokenization and index construction; each lexical pair shares an index; one in-process sample per method; repeated fresh-process builds below
methodology.resident_boundary: Query analysis, retrieval, scoring, top-5 selection, result shaping; full engines include routing and capability decoration
methodology.quality: 617 frozen regression queries and independent task-contract queries reported separately; no parameter fitting
methodology.negative_scores: Raw scores have algorithm-specific scales; the legacy score<10 rule applies only to full-engine regression
